name: Report Viewer
description: Perspective Report Viewer component - embeds reports from Reporting Module with PDF export and pagination
author: GitWay

source.description: Path of the report (case sensitive) from Reporting Module to display

params.description: Report parameters object - parameter names must match exactly to override defaults

page.description: Current page number displayed (updates as pages are viewed)

zoomLevel.description: Zoom level as percentage of report width

allowDownload.description: Show download icon in control bar for PDF export

downloadFilename.description: Custom filename for downloaded reports (defaults to report name if empty)

allowOpenInTab.description: Show icon to open PDF in new browser tab

backgroundColor.description: Background color for report display area

errorMessage.description: Message displayed if report fails to load

emptyMessage.description: Message displayed when source is empty

notes: Requires Reporting Module to be installed on Gateway
Source path is case-sensitive and must match exactly
Right-click report in Project Browser to Copy full Path
Parameter names must match report parameters exactly
Parameters override default report parameter values
Page property updates automatically as user navigates pages
pageCount property is read-only and shows total pages
Download icon disabled after click until save/cancel dialog
Empty source results in blank component display

pager.description: Displays current page and navigation buttons
pager.features: Previous/Next buttons, page number input, total pages

download.behavior: Disabled after click until save or cancel
download.filename: Uses downloadFilename or defaults to report name

popout.description: Opens report in new browser window

reportParameters.matching: Names must match report parameters exactly (case-sensitive)
reportParameters.types: Support all report parameter types (string, number, date, etc.)
reportParameters.binding: Can be bound to dynamic values

propertyBindings: page - Navigate to specific pages programmatically
zoomLevel - Control zoom via scripting or bindings
readOnlyProperties: pageCount - Total number of pages in report (read-only)

workflowExample.step2: Right-click report in Project Browser to copy path
workflowExample.step3: Add Report Viewer component to view
workflowExample.step5: Add any required parameters to 'params' object
workflowExample.step6: Configure toolbar controls (download, popout, zoom, pager)
workflowExample.step7: Style control bar and display area as needed

performanceConsiderations: Large reports may take time to load
Consider loading indicator for better UX
Page navigation is client-side after initial load
commonUseCases: Production reports embedded in operator dashboards
Real-time report generation with dynamic parameters
printingBehavior: Static content prints via Request Print action
Dynamic content may print incompletely due to loading delays
Charts and real-time data may not be fully rendered
Consider using PDF download for reliable printing
Use allowDownload to provide PDF export option
errorHandling: Invalid source path shows error in component
Missing Reporting Module prevents component use
Parameter type mismatches may cause report errors
Network issues can delay or prevent loading
Custom error messages via errorMessage parameter
